# Simeon Atanasov

> Free, practitioner-built resources on data protection, the EU AI Act and cookie compliance: reference digests of primary sources, practical advice, and browser-based assessment tools. Content is informational, not legal advice.

## Digests

- [AI Act Digest](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/ai-act-digest.html): The EU AI Act article by article, as amended by the 2026 Digital Omnibus, with takeaways, application dates and the guidance around it.
- [AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF Crosswalk](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/ai-governance-crosswalk.html): EU AI Act obligations for providers, deployers and GPAI model providers mapped to ISO/IEC 42001 clauses and Annex A controls and NIST AI RMF subcategories, with gaps marked, plus the NIST-hosted AI RMF to ISO/IEC 42001 crosswalk.
- [GDPR, ISO/IEC 27701:2019 and NIST Privacy Framework Crosswalk](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/privacy-crosswalk.html): 36 GDPR obligations for controllers and processors mapped to NIST Privacy Framework 1.0 subcategories on the site's own reading, and to ISO/IEC 27701 clauses in the 2019 numbering as published in the Data Protection Mapping Project, with gaps marked and reverse views by clause and by subcategory.
- [EDPB Digest](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/edpb-digest.html): Every European Data Protection Board document, 553 in all, with one takeaway each: what it establishes, who it binds and what to do.
- [Cookie Compliance Digest](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/cookie-digest.html): 263 cookie and tracking laws, regulator guidance documents, court decisions and enforcement actions across 66 jurisdictions, each with a takeaway.

## Advice

- [Practical Privacy](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/practical-privacy.html): A practitioner-tested privacy playbook for eighteen recurring situations, from surveillance and offboarding to marketing and breach response.
- [Practical AI Act Advice](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/practical-ai-act-advice.html): A working reference on the EU AI Act in thirteen topics: what applies to you, what you have to build, and what to check on other people's systems.
- [GDPR Enforcement in Europe](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/gdpr-enforcement.html): How a GDPR complaint becomes a fine, where the courts come in, and the enforcement route in all 30 EEA countries, with the UK and Switzerland for contrast.
- [Privacy Enforcement Worldwide](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/privacy-enforcement-worldwide.html): Who can fine for a privacy breach outside Europe, where the courts come in, and the enforcement route in 23 jurisdictions from the United States to Australia.

## Tools

- [Privacy & AI Risk Assessments](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/privacy-ai-assessment.html): Free privacy and AI governance assessments: privacy check, full DPIA, legitimate interest test, AI Act risk, breach severity, third-party security, fundamental rights impact, generative AI risk, transfer impact, and an AI assessment pathway that runs the AI tools as one with an impact level and framework coverage.
- [Notice and Policy Generators](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/notice-generators.html): Generate a privacy notice under the GDPR, the UK GDPR, the Swiss FADP, Brazil's LGPD, Canada's PIPEDA and provincial laws, India's DPDP Act, China's PIPL, Japan's APPI, South Korea's PIPA, Singapore's PDPA, Australia's Privacy Act, South Africa's POPIA, the California CCPA or the other US state privacy laws, an AI Act transparency notice, a data protection policy and an AI policy, each with a completeness check against the law.
- [GDPR Readiness Assessment](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/gdpr-readiness.html): An accountability-based GDPR readiness assessment: record the privacy activities you perform and see which GDPR Articles they evidence.
- [GDPR Fine Calculator](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/gdpr-fine-calculator.html): Benchmark a possible GDPR fine against published enforcement decisions: see what comparable organisations paid and the statutory ceiling.
- [GDPR Fines Analytics](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/gdpr-fines-analytics.html): Build your own chart of published GDPR fines by country, sector, authority, Article or year, then download it as PNG or CSV.
- [GDPR Fines Dashboard](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/power-bi.html): A Power BI dashboard of GDPR fines across Europe since 2018: enforcement trends, country breakdowns and company-level analysis.
- [Interactive Risk Matrix](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/risk-matrix-original.html): An interactive risk matrix for privacy and data protection: add risks, place them by likelihood and impact, assign mitigations and export.
- [Cookie Banner Scanner](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/cookie-banner-scanner.html): Run a cookie banner scan and export the results to Excel.

## Legal

- [Privacy Notice](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/privacy-notice.html): How this website collects, uses and protects personal data, and your rights as a data subject, including access, rectification and erasure.
- [Cookie Notice](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/cookie-notice.html): The cookies used on this website, what each one does, and how to manage your cookie preferences.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/terms.html): Terms of Use for this website: acceptable use, intellectual property, the informational nature of the tools and demos, and liability.

## Other

- [Asteroids Game](https://www.simeonatanasov.com/my-asteroids-game.html): A browser Asteroids game written in JavaScript: pilot a ship, dodge and destroy asteroids, with keyboard and touch controls.
